A made-up ninth day with hub, for the door scenarios. Nothing here was captured.

- hub.json: the tuner turned the dash check off.
- history.json: the history lines, with `hours_ago` in place of a time. The test turns each into a UTC time. The scout line is older than a day, so the strip leaves it out.
- offers.json: an open offer for the researcher part, with `hours_ago` too.
- researcher/part.json: a stand-in researcher part. The test copies it into the plugin copy only when the copy has none.
